documents.title: EU Commission Battery Carbon Footprint FAQ
documents.text:
# Official FAQ

Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 entered into force on 18 February 2024. Carbon footprint declarations are required for EV batteries placed on the EU market. Transition obligations phase in through 2027.

documents.title: Major Retailer Annual Report — Food Division
documents.text:
# Annual Report Excerpt

Our food division revenue grew 8% year-over-year. Supply chain resilience programs expanded across Europe. This document does not discuss battery chemistry or vehicle electrification.

documents.title: Fleet Emissions Comparison Note
documents.text:
# BEV vs ICE

Battery electric vans in the pilot achieved 62 g CO2/km well-to-wheel on the test cycle. Comparable diesel ICE vans averaged 185 g CO2/km in the same fleet study.

documents.title: Cathode Chemistry Engineering Brief
documents.text:
# LFP vs NMC

LFP cells trade lower energy density for improved thermal stability and cycle life. NMC chemistries reach higher volumetric energy density but require stricter thermal management in fast-charge scenarios.

documents.text: Advisory ADV-BMS-2024-09 references CVE-2024-1234 affecting telemetry stacks using OpenSSL 3.5.7. Product SS-CELL-900X requires firmware revision 3.5.7 or later.
